svg.title: Inside a module: Menus dependency diagram
svg.desc: All 24 local production import edges in Menus at baseline 0d5e64b, with its three surface packages grouped. Arrows point from importer to dependency. External imports are summarized separately.
svg.text: Menus makes the public entry, private implementation and shared values visible.
A → B means A imports B. Every arrow is a source dependency.
The facade → DAO edge includes schema registration. Model imports converge on values and policy vocabulary.
Surfaces cannot import their own internal packages.
Queries and handlers cannot import commands.
Commands and handlers cannot import domain facades.
Peer models, queries and events keep their owner.
Surfaces use matching toolkits and public facades.
Shared kernel, middleware and store support the module.

a.text: Go internal blocks peer access. arch-lint narrows access inside the owner’s tree.
Observed imports are shown above; the rules also reject forbidden imports that have not been written.

svg.text: Open the SVG to follow package links.
